summary: Use the token as a Bearer header: GET /api/controller/v2/hosts/ or POST to /api/controller/v2/job_templates/<id>/launch/ with JSON data such as a limit.
questions: How do I call the AAP API with a bearer token?
Launch a job template with an OAuth token

answer_card.title: Use an OAuth 2 token
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
curl -k -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  https://<platform-host>/api/controller/v2/hosts/

curl -k -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data '{"limit": "ansible"}' \
  https://<platform-host>/api/controller/v2/job_templates/14/launch/
```
